messages:
Asha: FYI Foxtail just returned the RFP with a compliance addendum and a last-minute ask for embedding throughput and burst pricing. They want a capability matrix + answers by EOD Friday. Link to doc: https://drive.redwood/foxtail/rfp-addendum :eyes:
Ravi: copying in — can you drop the exact asks here? do they want per-embedding QPS or per-second tokens?
Asha: They called out two numbers: sustained QPS for 512-token inputs and a 5-minute burst at 10x sustained. Also want latency SLO, quantization options, and any HSM/KMS deployment notes.
Lena: I skimmed the addendum — they require SOC2/ISO copies, KMS key rotation frequency, and an HSM option for Private deploy. Also an encryption-at-rest diagram (we can reuse the one from the Solara RFP).
Ravi: For throughput we should propose three tiers: Hosted standard (best-effort), Dedicated reserved (predictable), Private/Onprem with HSM. Quick sketch: Hosted: 50 QPS sustained @ 512 tokens (~1.8M tokens/min) with 150ms median embed latency; Dedicated (4xA100 equiv): 300 QPS sustained, 10-min burst to 3k QPS w/ autoscale + 90ms median; Private: depends on customer infra but we can provide benchmark matrix.
Kai: Do we have a prebuilt capability_matrix_v4.xlsx that maps these tiers to features (HSM, SOC2, latency, burst)? If not I can fork and add the Foxtail columns.
Asha: I uploaded a working draft: https://drive.redwood/foxtail/capability_matrix_v4.xlsx — please update rows for quantization (8-bit/4-bit) and include recommended billing tiers.
Ravi: For pricing snippet to include in the RFI: hosted per-embedding unit + overage; Dedicated: monthly base + commit discount + per-embedding unit for extra; burst pricing: charge per-minute of burst above commit at 2.5x base rate. I'll paste a short table into the response doc.
Lena: Security asks: provide KMS key rotation cadence (we do 90-day rotation by policy), HSM vendors supported (Thales, AWS CloudHSM, Azure Dedicated HSM), and note that Private customers can bring their own keys via our BYOK flow. Also confirm logging/retention — default 30d, enterprise retention add-on available.
Asha: Great. Action items: Ravi update throughput numbers and a short benchmark blurb; Kai update capability matrix spreadsheet; Lena attach SOC2 cert and the encryption diagram; I'll assemble the final RFI response and attach the matrix + pricing.
Ravi: Quick benchmark blurb (copy-paste ready): "On Redwood Dedicated (4xA100 equivalent), embeddings at 512 tokens achieve ~1200 embeddings/sec batched, median p99 latency 180ms; with autoscale we sustain 300 QPS and absorb 10x bursts for up to 10 minutes with graceful throttling policies." Use that as a starting point and I'll refine after tests.
DeployBot: deploy-request acknowledged — created ephemeral bench-run job foxtail-bench-4765439999, ETA results 2h.
Asha: Perfect, thanks. Can everyone drop their completed assets into the Foxtail folder by 17:00 PT tomorrow? I'll submit the RFI package to procurement then. :thumbsup: 
Lena: Will do, attaching SOC2 snapshot and diagram to the folder once legal signs off.
Kai: I'll finish the matrix and add a short note on quantization tradeoffs.
Ravi: I'll follow up with a condensed pricing table and attach perf logs after bench completes.
Asha: Thanks team — looping in legal if anything else pops up. @Ravi ping me when bench is done so I can paste final numbers into the RFI."
